  1430: const STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_STORE='uep-student-card-heat-v2';
  1431: const STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_PERIOD_STORE='uep-student-card-heat-period-v1';
  1432: function studentCardHeatId(student){return String(student?.id||student?.studentNo||'').trim();}
  1433: function studentCardHeatPeriodDays(){try{return localStorage.getItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_PERIOD_STORE)==='7'?7:30;}catch{return 30;}}
  1434: function setStudentCardHeatPeriodDays(days){const value=Number(days)===7?7:30;try{localStorage.setItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_PERIOD_STORE,String(value));}catch{}return value;}
  1435: function readStudentCardHeatStore(){try{const raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_STORE)||'{}');return raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};}catch{return {};}}
  1436: function writeStudentCardHeatStore(store){try{localStorage.setItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_STORE,JSON.stringify(store||{}));}catch{}}
  1437: function studentCardHeat(student){const id=studentCardHeatId(student);if(!id)return 0;const store=readStudentCardHeatStore(),cutoff=Date.now()-studentCardHeatPeriodDays()*86400000;const recent=(Array.isArray(store[id])?store[id]:[]).map(Number).filter(t=>Number.isFinite(t)&&t>=cutoff);return recent.length;}
  1438: function touchStudentCardHeat(student){const id=studentCardHeatId(student);if(!id)return 0;const store=readStudentCardHeatStore(),history=(Array.isArray(store[id])?store[id]:[]).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);history.push(Date.now());store[id]=history.filter(t=>t>=Date.now()-31*86400000).slice(-80);writeStudentCardHeatStore(store);return studentCardHeat(student);}
  1439: function studentHeatClass(student){const n=studentCardHeat(student);return n>=7?'heat-7':n===6?'heat-6':n===5?'heat-5':n===4?'heat-4':n===3?'heat-3':n===2?'heat-2':n===1?'heat-1':'heat-0';}

  1549: function dormRuleNormalizeDateTime(value){
  1550:   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='') return '';
  1551:   // Google Sheets 날짜 직렬값은 시트의 '현지 날짜/시간' 값이다.
  1552:   // UTC instant로 해석한 뒤 Asia/Seoul을 다시 적용하면 +9시간이 생기므로,
  1553:   // 직렬값의 날짜/시간 성분을 그대로 추출한다.
  1554:   if(typeof value==='number'||/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(String(value).trim())){
  1555:     const serial=Number(value);
  1556:     if(Number.isFinite(serial)&&serial>20000&&serial<100000){
  1557:       const d=new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+Math.round(serial*86400000));
  1558:       if(!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())){
  1559:         const y=d.getUTCFullYear(),m=String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  1560:         const hh=String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,'0'),mm=String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
  1561:         return `${y}-${m}-${day}T${hh}:${mm}`;
  1562:       }
  1563:     }
  1564:   }
  1565:   const raw=String(value).trim().replace(' ','T');
  1566:   const m=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})T(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  1567:   if(m) return `${m[1]}-${String(m[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(m[3]).padStart(2,'0')}T${String(m[4]).padStart(2,'0')}:${m[5]}`;
  1568:   return String(value).trim();
  1569: }

  1600: function dormRuleWeekdaysFromRange(start,end){
  1601:   const a=new Date(start),b=new Date(end);if(Number.isNaN(a.getTime())||Number.isNaN(b.getTime()))return '전체';
  1602:   const names=['일','월','화','수','목','금','토'],seen=[];
  1603:   const d=new Date(a);d.setHours(12,0,0,0);const stop=new Date(b);stop.setHours(12,0,0,0);
  1604:   let guard=0;while(d<=stop&&guard++<8){const n=names[d.getDay()];if(!seen.includes(n))seen.push(n);d.setDate(d.getDate()+1);}
  1605:   return guard>=8?'전체':seen.join(',');
  1606: }

  2612: function inputCenterClassifyMaterial(file={}, textValue=''){
  2613:   const name=String(file?.name||file?.fileName||'');
  2614:   const text=String(textValue||file?.text||'');
  2615:   const hay=`${name}\n${text.slice(0,12000)}`.toLowerCase();
  2616:   const rules=[
  2617:     {type:'프로그램 신청서',score:[/신청자|참가신청|신청 활동|신청 프로그램|희망 진로|희망순위|신청서/g,/연락처|학년|반|번호|이름/g],reason:'신청·희망·참가 관련 열/문구'},

  2619:     {type:'수행평가지',score:[/수행평가|서술형|평가지|배점|채점|문항|풀이/g,/교과|성취기준|평가요소/g],reason:'수행평가·채점 관련 문구'},
  2620:     {type:'보고서·탐구보고서',score:[/보고서|탐구|활동내용|새롭게 알게|느낀점|소감|주제/g,/책 제목|독서|진로희망|탐구내용/g],reason:'보고서·탐구·독서 관련 문구'},
  2621:     {type:'출결·참여명단',score:[/출석|결석|참여명단|참가자 명단|출결|출석부/g,/학번|이름|반/g],reason:'출결·참여명단 관련 문구'},
  2622:     {type:'성적·평가자료',score:[/성적|점수|등급|석차|평균|원점수|표준점수/g,/학번|이름|과목/g],reason:'성적·점수 관련 열/문구'},

  2857: async function inputCenterRunAutoOCR(drafts){

  2862:   for(const d of drafts){const pages=Array.isArray(d.pages)&&d.pages.length?d.pages:[{filePath:d.filePath}];const texts=[],engines=new Set(),errors=[];pages.forEach((p,i)=>{const r=byKey.get(`${d.draftId}::${i}`);if(!r)return;if(r.ok&&r.text)texts.push(`[${i+1}페이지]\n${r.text}`);if(r.engine)engines.add(r.engine);if(!r.ok)errors.push(`${i+1}p ${r.reason||r.status||'OCR 실패'}`);});d.text=texts.join('\n\n').trim();d.rawText=d.text;d.ocrEngine=[...engines].join(' + ');d.ocrError=errors.join(' / ');d.ocrStatus=errors.length?(d.text?'OCR확인필요':'OCR오류'):(d.text?'OCR완료':'OCR확인필요');inputCenterApplyOcrMatch(d);}

  2901: function inputCenterHumanReportText(value=''){
  2902:   const source=String(value||'').trim();if(!source)return '';
  2903:   try{
  2904:     const meta=JSON.parse(source);
  2905:     const fields=Array.isArray(meta?.fields)?meta.fields:Array.isArray(meta)?meta:[];
  2906:     const skip=/^(연락처|전화번호|휴대폰|서명|이메일|학번|성명|이름|학년|반|수정시간|제출시간|제출일시)$/;
  2907:     const pairs=fields.map((f,i)=>({label:String(f?.label||`문항 ${i+1}`).trim(),value:String(f?.value||'').trim()})).filter(x=>x.value&&!skip.test(x.label));
  2908:     if(pairs.length)return pairs.map(x=>`[${x.label||'문항'}]\n${x.value}`).join('\n\n');
  2909:   }catch{}
  2910:   return source;
  2911: }
  2912: function inputCenterReviewDisplayText(row={}){

  2916:   if(structured&&!/^\s*[\[{]/.test(structured))return structured;
  2917:   if(structured&&structured!==String(row.normalizedText||'').trim())return structured;
  2918:   return String(row.rawText||row.text||'').trim();
  2919: }

  3285: function printScorePackage(student,mode){

  3918: function accessAccountRole(account){

  4441: function actualNineGrade(row) {
  4442:   let rank = Number(String(row?.rank ?? "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g,""));
  4443:   let enrollment = Number(String(row?.enrollment ?? "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g,""));
  4444:   let derived=false;
  4445:   if((!Number.isFinite(rank)||rank<=0)&&Number.isFinite(scoreNumeric(row?.rawScore))){
  4446:     const raw=scoreNumeric(row.rawScore);
  4447:     const peers=(readonlyCache?.scoreRecords||[]).filter(peer=>
  4448:       peer?.scoreType==="내신"&&String(peer.exam||"")===String(row?.exam||"")&&String(peer.subject||"")===String(row?.subject||"")&&
  4449:       String(peer.year||"")===String(row?.year||"")&&String(peer.semester||"")===String(row?.semester||"")&&Number.isFinite(scoreNumeric(peer.rawScore))
  4450:     );
  4451:     if(peers.length){
  4452:       rank=peers.filter(peer=>scoreNumeric(peer.rawScore)>raw).length+1;
  4453:       if(!Number.isFinite(enrollment)||enrollment<=0)enrollment=peers.length;
  4454:       derived=true;
  4455:     }
  4456:   }
  4457:   if (!Number.isFinite(rank) || !Number.isFinite(enrollment) || rank <= 0 || enrollment <= 0) return null;
  4458:   const percentile = rank / enrollment * 100;
  4459:   const grade = percentile <= 4 ? 1 : percentile <= 11 ? 2 : percentile <= 23 ? 3 : percentile <= 40 ? 4 : percentile <= 60 ? 5 : percentile <= 77 ? 6 : percentile <= 89 ? 7 : percentile <= 96 ? 8 : 9;
  4460:   return { grade, percentile, rank, enrollment, derived, detail:`${rank}/${enrollment}명 = 상위 ${percentile.toFixed(1)}%${derived?' · 원점수 기준 추정석차':''}` };
  4461: }

  4465:   return { average, details };

  5718: function applySchoolRecordGuardrails(text){

  5720:   // 33_생기부작성절대규칙과 35_금지표현DB는 학교 검증 규칙이므로 완화하지 않고 최종 강제 적용한다.

  5725:     if(enabled&&/^N$/i.test(enabled))return;

  6798: function timetableMasterWeekDates(value){

  6853: function normalizeTeacherTimetableCell(cell){
  6854:   if(!cell)return null;
  6855:   if(typeof cell==="string")return {subject:cell,room:"",changed:false};
  6856:   if(Array.isArray(cell)){
  6857:     const subject=String(cell[1]||cell[0]||"").trim();
  6858:     const room=String(cell[3]||cell[2]||"").trim();
  6859:     return subject?{subject,room,changed:false}:null;
  6860:   }
  6861:   const subject=String(cell.subject||cell.subjectName||cell.name||cell.course||cell.className||"").trim();
  6862:   const room=String(cell.location||cell.room||cell.classroom||cell.gradeClass||cell.classNo||"").trim();
  6863:   return subject?{subject,room,changed:Boolean(cell.isChanged||cell.changed||cell.changeInfo),changeInfo:cell.changeInfo||""}:null;
  6864: }
  6865: function personalTimetableData() {

  7025: function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {
  7026:   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  7027:   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];
  7028:   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end);
  7029:   if (index >= 0) return { index, label: `현재 ${index + 1}교시` };
  7030:   if (minute < periods[0][0]) return { index: -1, label: "일과 시작 전" };
  7031:   if (minute > periods[6][1]) return { index: -1, label: "정규수업 종료" };
  7032:   if (minute >= 750 && minute < 820) return { index: -1, label: "점심시간" };
  7033:   return { index: -1, label: "쉬는 시간" };
  7034: }

  7381: function timetableClassColorKey(room){
  7382:   const match=String(room||"").match(/(?:^|\b)([123])-?(\d{1,2})(?:\b|$)/);

  8302: function normalizeTimetableGradeClass(row){
  8303:   const directGrade=Number(row?.grade??row?.학년??0);
  8304:   const directClass=Number(row?.classNo??row?.class??row?.반??0);
  8305:   if(directGrade>=1&&directGrade<=3&&directClass>=1&&directClass<=20)return {grade:directGrade,classNo:directClass};
  8306:   const raw=String(row?.classCode??row?.classroom??row?.학급??row?.반코드??row?.['학년반']??'').trim();
  8307:   const digits=raw.replace(/\D/g,'');
  8308:   if(digits.length===3){
  8309:     const grade=Number(digits[0]),classNo=Number(digits.slice(1));
  8310:     if(grade>=1&&grade<=3&&classNo>=1&&classNo<=20)return {grade,classNo};
  8311:   }
  8312:   if(digits.length===4){
  8313:     const grade=Number(digits[0]),classNo=Number(digits.slice(1,3));
  8314:     if(grade>=1&&grade<=3&&classNo>=1&&classNo<=20)return {grade,classNo};
  8315:   }
  8316:   return {grade:directGrade||1,classNo:directClass||Number(digits)||0};
  8317: }

 11117: function parseStudentLine(line) {
 11118:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
 11119:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
 11120:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
 11121:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
 11122:     : trimmed.includes(",")
 11123:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
 11124:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 11125:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
 11126: }
